title: BUGFIX — batch-produce duplicate ledger write: content-based dedup in writeLedgerFallback
rationale: batch-produce.ts writes two entries for every video: one from pipeline-registry.ts (logToPublishLedger) and one from writeLedgerFallback. Despite result.ledgerWritten = true being set by pipeline-registry, the flag check in writeLedgerFallback doesn't prevent the second write. Root cause unclear (possible ts-node module scope issue). Fix: add content-based dedup — read last 8KB of publish-ledger.jsonl and skip fallback write if runId already present. Belt-and-suspenders alongside the ledgerWritten flag check.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/batch-produce.ts: add content-based dedup check in writeLedgerFallback — read last 8KB of publish-ledger.jsonl and return early if runId is already present.
